message.text: I'm looking at the memos repository structure to identify the entity types defined in the store package. I need to search for struct definitions across the store directory files to understand what data models are available.

The grep command didn't work, so I'll give it another shot in case it was a temporary issue.The grep tool isn't working, so I'll try a different approach using find with Python or fall back to grep with the recursive flag instead of relying on ripgrep.

I'm identifying the core entity types that map to database rows—these include Attachment, AuthenticationConfigState/Mutation, IdentityProvider, Inbox, InstanceSetting, Memo, MemoRelation, MemoShare, Reaction, User, UserIdentity, UserSetting, and DeploymentConfiguration (which isn't exported).

Now I need to figure out which of these types is most widely referenced across the codebase outside the store layer. I'll search for references to each type (like "store.Memo", "store.User", etc.) across the server, internal, cmd, and proto directories, then count how many distinct packages reference each one to find the most heavily used entity type.

args.command:
cd /bench/repo && for t in Attachment IdentityProvider Inbox InstanceSetting Memo MemoRelation MemoShare Reaction User UserIdentity UserSetting; do
  cnt=$(grep -rl "store\.${t}\b" --include=*.go . | grep -v "^./store/" | xargs -r -n1 dirname | sort -u | wc -l)
  echo "$t: $cnt"
done

h11.

In the [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) Go codebase, the persistent entity structs are defined directly in the `store` package (e.g. `store/user.go`, `store/memo.go`, `store/attachment.go`, `store/reaction.go`, `store/inbox.go`, `store/memo_relation.go`, `store/memo_share.go`, `store/user_setting.go`, `store/user_identity.go`, `store/instance_setting.go`, `store/idp.go`).

Searching all Go files outside `/bench/repo/store` for `store.<Type>` references and counting the distinct importing packages:

- `store.User`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss` → 7 packages
- `store.Memo`: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload` → 6 packages
- (next closest: `store.Attachment` at 4 packages — `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`)

Answer: 1st: `User` (~7 packages); 2nd: `Memo` (~6 packages)
